vocab.upgradeEn: Use effective way/method/strategy instead of good way.

meaningEn: This study word helps Becky talk about learning and progress more precisely.

promptEn: China drill: read the Chinese meaning, shadow the example twice, then make one Becky-style sentence with "effective" using To improve this answer, I should...

sourceEn: This harder word is auto-picked for Becky and refreshes every day with a China-friendly output drill.
